proposed_rule: Before ranking a vcmxmul candidate with large retained output vectors, estimate live rows and compile a reduced probe; stop after repeated identical register-allocation or Venus-merge assertions.
proposed_linter_hint: Warn when vcmxmul is introduced while two or more maximum-capacity return vectors remain live across the operation; suggest shortening return live ranges or a reduced compiler probe.

observed_failures: MachineInstr::getOperand out of range in register allocation or Venus merge
Register already assigned in register allocation

limitations: This is a compiler-context guard, not a claim that vcmxmul itself is unsupported.
A reduced positive probe and fresh RTL evidence are required before promotion to live knowledge.
